title: Editing bridge autoconnect in KDE resets NetworkManager connection.autoconnect-ports
line: Saving a bridge connection in the network settings no longer resets its "connect ports automatically" setting to the default.
explanation: When a connection is saved, the editor (ConnectionEditorBase::setting()) builds fresh ConnectionSettings from its widgets and copies back only the id, uuid and interface name. No widget edits connection.autoconnect-slaves, and networkmanager-qt always serialises it, so every save sent -1 (default); NetworkManager replaces the whole profile on Update, so a bridge's autoconnect-slaves/autoconnect-ports went from 1 to -1. The change copies autoconnect-slaves from the edited connection, next to the uuid.

commits.message:
editor: Keep autoconnect-slaves when saving a connection

Saving a bridge reset its autoconnect-ports setting to the default,
because the editor rebuilds the settings from its widgets and none of
them edits this one. Keep the value the connection already had.

BUG: 517317

patches.diff:
From 60700660a64fb0b857182b9bdc26d1426880e6e0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:18:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] editor: Keep autoconnect-slaves when saving a connection

Saving a bridge reset its autoconnect-ports setting to the default,
because the editor rebuilds the settings from its widgets and none of
them edits this one. Keep the value the connection already had.

BUG: 517317
---
 libs/editor/connectioneditorbase.cpp | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/libs/editor/connectioneditorbase.cpp b/libs/editor/connectioneditorbase.cpp
index 347356b76..21c64ac65 100644
--- a/libs/editor/connectioneditorbase.cpp
+++ b/libs/editor/connectioneditorbase.cpp
@@ -137,6 +137,7 @@ NMVariantMapMap ConnectionEditorBase::setting() const
         }
     }
     connectionSettings->setUuid(m_connection->uuid());
+    connectionSettings->setAutoconnectSlaves(m_connection->autoconnectSlaves());
 
     if (connectionSettings->connectionType() == NetworkManager::ConnectionSettings::Wireless) {
         NetworkManager::WirelessSecuritySetting::Ptr securitySetting =
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: unticking 'Connect automatically' on bridge br-test (autoconnect-ports/slaves = 1) and pressing Apply sends and stores autoconnect-slaves = -1.
With the fix: the same Apply keeps autoconnect-slaves = 1.

review.text: One line in ConnectionEditorBase::setting() keeps autoconnect-slaves from the edited connection, the same way the uuid is kept. That fixes the reported reset with no side effects for other connection types, and new connections still get the default. The editor still rebuilds the other unedited properties from defaults, but that is a separate issue. The mock-NM before/after shows the stored value going from -1 back to 1.
